annotations.text:
Issue #111 — what shape should the light-mode ink ramp be?
Secondary text fails AA in light mode (3.33–3.52:1), and #106 left the ramp non-monotonic: inkHint at 0.73 sits above inkSecondary at 0.62.
Dark mode already passes everywhere and is shown only to confirm nothing gets heavier there.
The keycap chip is the worst background, not the panel: its own fill darkens what sits behind the glyph. 0.74 clears the panel but not the chip — 0.75 is the lowest value that clears all three.
